references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to make a gold plate with the inscription 'Holy to the Lord' and attach it to the turban with a blue cord.
The turban (mitsnefet) is mentioned as part of the holy garments that were to be made for Aaron.
The preceding verse describing the gold plate itself, bearing the inscription 'Holy to the Lord,' which the blue cord was to attach.
The blue cord (petil tekhelet) is also used in the tassels on the garments as a reminder of the Lord's commands.
The turban and the holy diadem are placed on Aaron during the consecration ceremony.
Moses places the turban on Aaron's head with the gold plate at the front, as described in the consecration ritual.
Direct connection between the command (28:37) and its exact fulfillment (39:31).
